UserSync.title: UserSync
UserSync.description: Per-user cloud-synced music library preferences including playlists, favorite track IDs, theme customizer settings, home screen widget layout, and imported track metadata.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the document owner.

playlists.description: Bounded list (max 50) of user playlists synced across PC and Android.

favoriteIds.description: Bounded list (max 200) of favorited track IDs.

themePrefs.description: Liquid Glass theme and UI customizer preferences.

homeLayout.description: Bounded list (max 10) of Home widget order and visibility configurations.

savedTracks.description: Bounded list (max 150) of external/imported track metadata referenced by playlists and favorites.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud sync profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud sync profile was last updated.

/userSync/{userId}.description: Stores isolated per-user cloud sync state keyed by the authenticated user's UID.
